responsibility: GNAT’s integration layer with GCC’s exception-unwinding machinery. It bridges Ada exceptions to the active GCC unwinder model, wraps or re-exports key _Unwind entry points, defines Ada/C++ exception-class conventions, collaborates with Ada-side occurrence setup and unhandled-exception handling, and contains target-specific personality and SEH glue for propagating Ada exceptions through native unwind infrastructures. This is the core GCC-EH backend for Ada raising and propagation, unlike raise.c which only contains shared termination helpers.
